tools.name: plentymarkets_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (sales orders, returns, credit notes ...) with filters. Newest first with sort_by createdAt and sort_order desc. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}; each entry has the id, typeId (1 = sales order), statusId, plentyId, createdAt, amounts and the order items unless add_orde

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, amounts, dates, properties, order items, address relations. Add related data with `with` (addresses, comments, payments, documents, shippingPackages ...). GET /rest/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_order_status_history
tools.description: The status changes of an order: which status, when, and by which user. GET /rest/orders/{orderId}/status-history.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_order_statuses
tools.description: The order statuses defined in the system (id and name per language), to translate a statusId. Optionally a range of status ids. GET /rest/orders/statuses.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_order_referrers
tools.description: The order referrers (sales channels: shop, eBay, Amazon, ...) with their ids, for the referrer_id filter of plentymarkets_list_orders. GET /rest/orders/referrers.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_comments
tools.description: The comments (internal notes) on an order, an order item, a contact or a category. GET /rest/comments/{referenceType}/{referenceValue}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_items
tools.description: List items (the product containers) with filters. Prices, stock, barcodes and SKUs belong to the variations: use plentymarkets_list_variations for those. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}. GET /rest/items.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_item
tools.description: Get one item by id: flags, manufacturer, texts, condition, age rating and the item-level settings. GET /rest/items/{itemId}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_variations
tools.description: Search variations (the sellable products: number, SKU, barcodes, prices, stock, categories). Filter by item, number, barcode, SKU, active flag, category, warehouse. Use `with` for the related data (variationSalesPrices, variationBarcodes, stock, variationCategories, images ...). GET /rest/items/vari

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_categories
tools.description: List item categories (the category tree: id, parent, level, type, names with `with` details). GET /rest/categories.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_manufacturers
tools.description: List the manufacturers (brands) of the items: id, name, address data. GET /rest/items/manufacturers.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_sales_prices
tools.description: List the sales price configurations (price types such as retail or purchase price: id, type, names, which stores, countries and currencies they apply to). The prices of a variation: plentymarkets_list_variations with variationSalesPrices. GET /rest/items/sales_prices.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_stock
tools.description: List physical stock per variation and warehouse (physical stock, net stock, reserved, reorder level), optionally for one variation or changed since a date. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}. GET /rest/stockmanagement/stock.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (id, name, type, priority, address settings). GET /rest/stockmanagement/warehouses.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, ...). Returns personal data of your customers (names, emails, addresses). Filter by email, name, number, type, postal code or town; `with` adds addresses, options (email, phone), accounts, orderSummary. GET /rest/accounts/contacts.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id (customer personal data). Add addresses or accounts with `with` (the relations documented for this single-contact route). GET /rest/accounts/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_add_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal comment to an order, order item, contact, category or variation (an additive note, nothing is overwritten). By default the comment is NOT visible to the customer; only make it visible when the user explicitly asks. POST /rest/comments.

tools.name: plentymarkets_update_order_status
tools.description: WRITE: move an order to another status. This can trigger the event procedures configured in the system (customer emails, stock bookings, documents, shipping), so confirm the target status with the user first (plentymarkets_list_order_statuses has the ids). Only the status is sent. PUT /rest/orders/{

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plentymarkets_get_order, plentymarkets_list_comments, plentymarkets_list_contacts · Private data: plentymarkets_get_order, plentymarkets_list_comments, plentymarkets_list_contacts, plentymarkets_get_contact, plentymarkets_add_comment, plentymarkets_update_order_status · Public sink: plentymarkets_list_contacts, plentymarkets_add_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plentymarkets_get_order, plentymarkets_list_comments, plentymarkets_list_contacts · Private data: plentymarkets_get_order, plentymarkets_list_comments, plentymarkets_list_contacts, plentymarkets_get_contact, plentymarkets_add_comment, plentymarkets_update_order_status · Public sink: plentymarkets_list_contacts, plentymarkets_add_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
